name: HeyAll
tagline: Event-planning app that puts hosts and suppliers on one schedule, guest list and chat
role: React Native app by the Softwhere team for an Australian client

scenes.title: Where hosts meet suppliers
scenes.body: Hosts invite suppliers from an in-app directory; each one accepts and joins the shared event.

scenes.title: A countdown on every event
scenes.body: The host dashboard ticks down to the day and links schedule, guests and suppliers.

scenes.title: One run sheet for the whole crew
scenes.body: Hosts add timed schedule items; every supplier on the event sees the same plan.

scenes.title: Guest list with RSVP status
scenes.body: Attendance status and a note per guest, grouped A–Z and exportable as a PDF.

scenes.title: A real-time chat for each event
scenes.body: A Firestore group thread for the host and every supplier, backed by push notifications.

scenes.title: A calendar for suppliers
scenes.body: Booked days are marked on a month view; tap a date to see its events or add your own.
